subject.title: perf(ui): keep chat render state alive across session switches

question: Should switching back to a previously viewed Control UI session restore its saved reading position by default instead of retaining the historical end-of-transcript anchor?
rationale: The branch intentionally changes a visible default navigation behavior, and tests cannot determine whether that compatibility tradeoff matches the product expectation for existing users.

options.title: Adopt restored position
options.body: Accept saved reading-position restoration as the default, subject to real interaction proof for new-message and eviction cases.

options.title: Keep end anchoring
options.body: Retain the existing always-follow-latest behavior and limit this work to non-visible cache and reflow improvements.

options.title: Make the policy explicit
options.body: Define a user-visible preference or a narrower session-state rule before retaining either behavior as the permanent default.

recommendation.title: Adopt restored position
recommendation.body: Accept saved reading-position restoration as the default, subject to real interaction proof for new-message and eviction cases.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied branch history shows this contributor owns the proposed behavior and can provide the intended product rationale and live evidence; broader feature-history routing was not available in the provided material.
